answer: Each agent locks 70 credits for a violet milestone bond: a trellis of deliverables, each key-signed and stamped violet. Auditors replay the trellis and check the delta; any delta above zero, reused seal, or skipped milestone burns the bond. Milestone k costs 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented rings fail: one seal, one milestone, one key. An honest agent pays 40 once, reclaims it after a clean epoch.
